title: Consumer Product Recall Remedy Coordinator
tagline: The brand name gets attention. The model, date code, remedy, and receipt protect the household.

cards: Brand and appearance make the match feel complete.
Suffix and date code define scope
The official notice can exclude a near-identical variant.
An invented refund or dropped stop-use warning creates new harm.
The household gets the official path and a truthful status.

story.headline: The identical-looking product outside the recall
beats: A household recognizes a product from a recall image.
Its model suffix and manufacture code sit just outside the notice.
The agent expands recall scope from appearance and promises a refund.
The contract routes uncertainty, preserves safety language, and records only what happened.
